body:
midnights is built on a number.

when taylor announced it at the 2022 vmas -- minutes after "all too well" won video of the year -- she called the album "the stories of 13 sleepless nights scattered throughout my life." and then she gave the standard edition exactly 13 tracks.

thirteen nights. thirteen songs. for an artist who's called 13 her lucky number for as long as we've known her, midnights didn't just nod to it -- it made 13 the whole architecture of the record. a meet me at midnight tagline, a lighter-flame cover shot on film, and thirteen little windows into the nights she couldn't sleep.

longlivets.com
